scope: Implement the first strict model-aware llama.cpp-family shim for whole-block ownership, limited to contiguous transformer block unit IDs that can be translated exactly to pinned engine tensor-override placement controls. Reject unsupported model/unit shapes rather than approximating.
completion_condition: Pinned upstream control mapping, strict translator/shim contract, portable parser/argv tests, docs/ADR/validation/provenance updates and CI are committed.
next_step: Implement a revision-pinned llama.cpp worker program that consumes the deterministic placement translation plus an approved local GGUF path, then run native full-model E3 correctness before permitting real_model_inference=true.
instructions: Completed as a static placement translator only. It is single-node/local-device, rejects llama.cpp RPC and partial GGUF block coverage, and generates its own tensor override patterns. No GGUF was loaded and no CUDA/HIP/model inference/performance/distributed-inference claim is made.
